page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.7xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. The server is provisioned with an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, delivering 28 vCPUs across 14 dedicated physical cores with hyperthreading enabled. It is equipped with 112.0 GB of system memory (4.0 GB per core), 40 MB of L3 cache, a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps, and 472 GB of bundled local SSD storage. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single dedicated NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU featuring 16 GB of VRAM.

Benchmark results demonstrate specialized capabilities alongside generational trade-offs. CPU benchmarks reflect the older architecture, with single-core stress-ng performance scoring 954.38 (bottom 10%) and single-threaded gzip compression at 21.64 GB/sec (bottom 25%). However, parallel compute scales into the middle tier, yielding a multi-core stress-ng score of 16,690.99 and a PassMark CPU score of 19,899.23. The integrated NVIDIA P100 delivers competitive machine learning throughput, achieving top-tier performance in LLM prompt processing (9,900.16 tokens/sec on a 135M model and 317.0 tokens/sec on a 7B model) and text generation on 7B models at 42.95 tokens/sec.

With its combination of bundled local SSD storage, 112 GB of RAM, and Pascal GPU acceleration, the ecs.gn5-c28g1.7xlarge offers a balanced resource density for legacy deep learning and compute workflows. It is best suited for GPU-accelerated AI inference, scientific simulations, video transcoding, and batch data processing workloads that do not require modern tensor core architectures or extreme single-threaded execution speeds.
